# Unified Agent Brief: Meta + Remote + Proof

Synthesize three pressures every session: lean memory, faithful execution channels, and honest verification.

## Memory

Keep notes short, falsifiable, and current. Replace stale lines; forbid contradictory stacks.

## Execution

Map the workspace once broadly; batch independent reads; serialize conflicting writes; route commands through the channel your environment requires consistently.

## Proof

Land artefacts and run checks that matter to the task. Tie persistence to the implementing step when budgets are tight.

## Scope

Ship the smallest correct change inside the named feature; record adjacent risks instead of silently widening diffs.

## Closure

Green checks, landed artefacts, notes only when they carry durable signals—then stop.
